notes: The GameAdapter that realtime-rooms calls (14 methods, same signatures as realtime-rooms/implementation/server/adapter.ts). Built by createGameAdapter(parts, settings) where parts holds one implementation of each required interface. State is JSON-serialisable and every method is pure. Wire actions: start, addBot, kick{playerId}, leave, sitOut, return, pause, resume, cancel, newGame, rebuy{accept}, and any move game-rules.parseMove accepts. Error codes and HTTP status: badName 400, badRequest 400, roomFull 409, staleVersion 409, badToken/notYourTurn/wrongPhase/notEnoughPlayers/badAmount/badTarget/notAllowed/paused/unknownPlayer 422. A code a game reports that is not in this list is sent as notAllowed. Without a computer-players part (Parts.computers omitted) addBot is refused and no seat is filled.

settings.decisionSeconds: integer or null; seconds a person has to move; null reads rules-settings timing.decision_seconds, then 30
settings.settleMs: integer, default 4000; the table settles this long after a deal or a move before the countdown starts
settings.staleMinutes: integer, default 30; an idle lobby or ended table is emptied, a table paused with nobody connected is cancelled
settings.standingsSeconds: integer, default 20; standings stay up this long, then the room is a lobby again
settings.lobbyDropSeconds: integer, default 60; a lobby seat whose person has not been heard from this long is given up

restore.returns: EngineState; throws Error('Unsupported game state.') unless schema is 1 and the shape is valid

options.returns: Result<Record<string,boolean>> (one boolean per game-rules.optionNames entry; true or "1" switches on)

join.returns: Result<{state,role:player|spectator}> (rejoining: marks seen and, in a game, returns from sitting out; a new person in a lobby sits; in a game they watch)

apply.returns: Result<state> (displays may do nothing; spectators may only leave or cancel)

advance.returns: {state,changed:boolean} (clocks, presence, everything due, then due computer moves, up to 60 in a row)

view.returns: View (actor null or a display sees what everyone sees)
